definitions.explanation: A ticket or coupon that lets the holder receive something without paying — a meal, a drink, admission, or a service.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無料券|むりょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a free coffee voucher.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{無料券|むりょうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今月|こんげつ}{末|まつ}→今月末：28384_kongetsumatsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{使|つか}えます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This free voucher can be used until the end of this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無料券|むりょうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きません→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: I have two free movie tickets, so would you like to go see something together this weekend?

notes:
⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (free of charge) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket, coupon). Counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧. Often handed out as a promotion or given as an apology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料券|むりょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a free ticket
- {無料券|むりょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a free ticket
- {無料券|むりょうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期限切|きげんぎ}れ→期限切れ：15893_kigengire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: for a free ticket to expire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割引券|わりびきけん}→割引券：09545_waribikiken⟧: discount coupon — reduces the price rather than removing it
- ⟦{招待券|しょうたいけん}→招待券：20509_shoutaiken⟧: invitation ticket — free admission, but framed as an invitation from the organizer
